description: This PHP source file defines a class ImportViewLast extending ImportView, used for rendering the last step view in an import process within SuiteCRM. The class manages displaying import status, results, error and duplicate records, and provides interactions such as buttons and JavaScript for user interface behavior.

classes.name: ImportViewLast
classes.description: A class that manages the display of the final import summary, including status information, result listing, and user interactions for the import process in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import summary view, including status, counts, result tables, and interface elements.

methods.name: getListViewResults
methods.description: Generates HTML content for listing imported records via ListViewFacade.

methods.name: getListViewTableFromFile
methods.description: Creates a table view from a given CSV file for displaying error, duplicate, or result records.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Provides JavaScript code injected into the view for interface behaviors like tab switching and table refresh.

methods.name: _addToProspectListButton
methods.description: Returns HTML for a button that adds imported prospects to a target prospect list.
